He stood a long while, listening to the swell, then climbed the ninety-two steps and trimmed the wick, though the sun was already up.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台刚刚冷却下来的机器。高架桥上的路灯还亮着，光落在空荡荡的路面上，被风吹得微微发晃。便利店的白光里，店员在补货，自动门开了又合，没有人进来。远处的写字楼只剩零星几扇窗亮着，像没睡着的眼睛。清洁车缓缓驶过，水痕在柏油上泛着青色。偶尔有一辆出租车经过，尾灯拖出短短的红线，然后一切又安静下来。天还没有亮，可空气里已经有了一点将醒未醒的凉意。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a job solves itself by doing one small piece and then handing a smaller copy of the same job to itself.\n• Every recursive job needs a stopping rule, like 'when there's only one box left, just open it' — otherwise it keeps handing off smaller copies forever.\n• Think of nested boxes: open one, find a smaller box inside, open that, and repeat until you hit the tiny box that's already empty."}
